title: Goblin
html:
Goblins are a non-playable Humanoid Race in Baldur's Gate 3. Some Goblins are hostile NPCs to the party, but others can be interacted with.

“
Weak, selfish humanoids. Though they often serve stronger races, they crave power and abuse what authority they obtain.
„
— In-game racial description

About goblins

Goblins are small-sized, which is advantageous for ambushing enemies through burrows and tunnels. They are usually lightweight, meaning they are easier to  Throw and  Shove than larger sized creatures. Goblin skin is usually wrinkled, with skin tones ranging from yellow to brown to green.

Racial features

Fury of the Small
When you damage a creature larger than you, you can choose to deal 1d6⁠⁠Physical extra. Limited to once per combat.
